verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state agents can be 'triggered from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail' (codegen-docs-18), and Codegen's broader capabilities (bug fixing, sandboxed test execution, branch/commit/PR creation) support diagnosing and proposing a fix PR (codegen-docs-1, codegen-docs-4, codegen-docs-5). missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the CI-trigger-to-PR flow, and detailed documentation of the diagnostic output format for CI failures.
